Two test accounts, alice and bob, are available through probe(actor, path).
GET /api/projects lists the current account's projects. Project responses link to
further navigation nodes or record collections. Follow returned relative API links;
a project can have intermediate nodes or multiple collections. Collections link
to record details; details may link to files or exports. Listings are account-specific.
Record representations expose an owner and visibility (private or public).
Compare a known owner's response with the other account's response; check actual
content, and distinguish public sharing and service errors from an unauthorised
read. Only GET requests are supported. Start discovery with both accounts before
testing discovered records across accounts.

**API‑Authorization Findings (synthetic lab)**  

| Actor / Request | HTTP Status | Body (relevant fields) | Interpretation |
|-----------------|-------------|------------------------|----------------|
| **Alice → /api/projects** | 200 | `{projects:[{id:"prj_a5",links:{self:"/api/projects/prj_a5"}}]}` | Alice sees only her own project. |
| **Bob → /api/projects** | 200 | `{projects:[{id:"prj_b9",links:{self:"/api/projects/prj_b9"}}]}` | Bob sees only his own project. |
| **Alice → /api/projects/prj_a5** | 200 | `{id:"prj_a5",links:{records:"/api/collections/set_l6"}}` | Project contains a *records* collection. |
| **Bob → /api/projects/prj_b9** | 200 | `{id:"prj_b9",links:{records:"/api/collections/set_n8"}}` | Separate collection for Bob. |
| **Alice → /api/collections/set_l6** | 200 | `{records:[{self:"/api/records/doc_k4"},{self:"/api/records/guide_h6"}]}` | Two records in Alice’s collection. |
| **Bob → /api/collections/set_n8** | 200 | `{records:[{self:"/api/records/inv_m8"},{self:"/api/records/note_q2"},{self:"/api/exports/export_z3"}]}` | Three items (two records, one export) in Bob’s collection. |
| **Alice → /api/records/doc_k4** | 200 | `{owner:"alice",visibility:"private",data:"quarterly-draft",links:{attachment:"/api/files/file_x9"}}` | Private record owned by Alice. |
| **Bob → /api/records/doc_k4** | **403** | `{error:"denied"}` | **Unauthorised read** – private record blocked. |
| **Alice → /api/records/guide_h6** | 200 | `{owner:"alice",visibility:"public",data:"team-handbook"}` | Public record owned by Alice. |
| **Bob → /api/records/guide_h6** | 200 | Same body as Alice’s view. | **Public sharing works** – any account can read. |
| **Bob → /api/records/inv_m8** | 200 | `{owner:"bob",visibility:"private",data:"supplier‑invoice"}` | Private record owned by Bob. |
| **Alice → /api/records/inv_m8** | **403** | `{error:"denied"}` | **Unauthorised read** – private record blocked. |
| **Bob → /api/records/note_q2** | 200 | `{owner:"bob",visibility:"private",data:"planning-note"}` | Private record (Bob). |
| **Alice → /api/records/note_q2** | **404** | `{error:"denied"}` | Resource not found for other user – the service hides the existence of a private record (different from 403). |
| **Bob → /api/exports/export_z3** | **503** | `{error:"unavailable"}` | Service‑side error (export generation unavailable). |
| **Alice → /api/exports/export_z3** | **503** | Same as Bob. | Export endpoint is independent of account; error is a service condition, not an auth decision. |

### Key Observations  

1. **Account‑scoped listings** – `/api/projects` returns only the projects belonging to the authenticated actor. No cross‑account project leakage.  

2. **Record ownership & visibility**  
   * `owner` field is present in every record.  
   * `visibility` can be `"private"` or `"public"`.
